title: Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.40302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models for coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography often perform poorly on data from centres that were not represented in training. Apart from differences in equipment, the labels of the largest public dataset (ARCADE) are incomplete, as only the segments defined in the SYNTAX score are annotated. In this study, we evaluated whether self-training with pseudo-labels can improve performance on external data without additional manual annotation. Pseudo-labels were generated from two sources, namely the predictions of an nnU-Net model trained on ARCADE and a contrast map obtained by subtracting a pre-contrast frame from the same sequence. The nnU-Net predictions were extended along the contrast map, and pixels detected only in the subtraction image were assigned an ignore label and excluded from the loss. Six models were trained and tested on ARCADE and on two external datasets (XCAD and XACV). All first-round model

translated_title: 利用造影前帧减影实现X射线血管造影跨中心冠状动脉血管分割的自训练方法
translated_abstract: 用于X射线血管造影中冠状动脉血管分割的深度学习模型，在来自训练集中未包含的中心的数据上往往表现不佳。除了设备差异外，最大的公开数据集（ARCADE）的标注并不完整，因为只有SYNTAX评分中定义的血管节段被标注。在本研究中，我们评估了使用伪标签进行自训练能否在无需额外人工标注的情况下提升模型在外部数据上的性能。伪标签来自两个来源：其一是在ARCADE上训练的nnU-Net模型的预测结果，其二是通过从同一序列中减去造影前帧获得的对比图。nnU-Net的预测沿对比图进行扩展，而仅在减影图像中检测到的像素被赋予忽略标签并从损失计算中排除。共训练了六个模型，并在ARCADE以及两个外部数据集（XCAD和XACV）上进行了测试。所有第一轮模型……
tldr: 该研究提出利用造影前帧减影生成的对比图对nnU-Net伪标签进行扩展与修正，通过自训练在无需额外人工标注的情况下显著提升了冠状动脉血管分割模型在跨中心外部数据上的泛化性能。
